targets.old_statement: A courteous driver follows speed limits and allows other road users time and space.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A courteous driver follows speed limits and allows other road users time and space.
targets.statement: To keep from becoming an aggressive motorist, obey the posted speed limit and remain courteous and patient behind the wheel.

targets.old_statement: Keep pets away from the driver's lap and driving controls, and never leave them alone in the vehicle.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Keep pets away from the driver's lap and driving controls, and never leave them alone in the vehicle.
targets.statement: Keep pets away from yourself while driving, never let them sit on your lap or lean at the driver-side window, and never leave a pet unattended inside the car.
